title: Whispers of Many Shores: Cultural Alignment through Collaborative Cultural Expertise

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating user profiles from 20 countries across 8 global regions (based on World Value Survey data) and evaluating model responses using an LLM-as-a-Judge protocol to calculate metrics such as Cultural Alignment Score (CAS), Cultural Alignment Variance (CAV), Cultural Diversity (Shannon Entropy), and Sensitive Topic Coverage.
